description: Only after the user confirms what happened: record that a cancellation went through, that they kept the service for less, that they got stuck, or that the steps had changed (and at which step). Adds one to anonymous public counters that keep the cancel library current; stores no personal data and no free text. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses): don't send personal data or secrets.

service.description: The service, as passed to get_exit_plan

step.description: For blocked or steps_changed: the step number where it stopped matching
